title: Camp Grafton

services.name: School Groups
services.desc: Teachers, Principals- are you considering a multi-day camping experience for young people this year? Or perhaps a day trip to the great outdoors? Camp Grafton, on the beautiful Shuswap Lake, can help you bring this idea to life. Camp Grafton has cabins for 52 campers, a commercial grade kitchen, and a dining hall/craft hall. The camp offers a range of recreational options: canoeing, swimming, and archery. Its highly-skilled, university-aged summer staff can organize orienteering, environmental hikes, wide games, and campfire celebrations.
